events.title: API - First Approach to build Apps with strapi CMS
events.description: Learn the principles of API-first development and headless CMS architectures, leveraging Strapi to build highly decoupled, performant, and scalable applications.

events.title: Developing Re-usable Django apps
events.description: Deep dive into Django best practices, code modularization, packaging, and structure to create robust, plug-and-play reusable web applications.

events.title: Level-up your Frontend Development with ASTRO.BUILD
events.description: Master Astro's island architecture to ship zero client-side JavaScript by default, achieving unmatched web performance and modern developer experience.

events.title: Upgrading from Drupal 9 to Drupal 10
events.description: A comprehensive migration walkthrough for systems administrators and Drupal developers upgrading core databases, security layers, and modules from Drupal 9 to 10.

events.title: Demystifying JavaScript Bundlers
events.description: Understand what happens under the hood when building Javascript applications. A deep comparison of Webpack, Rollup, Vite, and ESBuild.

events.title: Intro to NativeScript
events.description: Build truly native mobile apps for iOS and Android using JavaScript/TypeScript skills without learning native platforms.

events.title: Automate Workflows using n8n
events.description: Harness open-source workflow automation with n8n. Connect APIs, databases, and message queues visually with self-hosted node servers.

events.title: Build Native Addons with Node - API
events.description: Unlock C/C++ speed in Node.js applications by writing high-performance native addons using the Node-API (N-API) standard.

events.title: Backend as a Service - AppWrite
events.description: Accelerate your application development workflow with Appwrite, a secure self-hosted Backend-as-a-Service featuring Auth, Databases, Storage, and Functions.

events.title: ChatGPT and Startups
events.description: Explore the commercial possibilities of large language models, prompt engineering patterns, and the integration of GPT models into startup products.

events.title: Intro to Rust Tooling and Ecosystem
events.description: Dive into Rust's system safety guarantees, package management with Cargo, compiler warnings, test runners, and build optimizations.

events.title: Understanding Types using Set theory
events.description: Demystify type systems, compiler design, and static validation by viewing data types through the lens of mathematical set theory.

events.title: Why SVELTE is next big thing in Web Development
events.description: Learn how Svelte shifts work from the browser to build-time, compiling components to highly optimized, tiny vanilla JavaScript code with no Virtual DOM overhead.

events.title: Future of REACT
events.description: Unpack the latest features in React, including React Server Components (RSC), hydration enhancements, streaming SSR, and architectural changes.

events.title: Solid.JS and Signals
events.description: Explore the fine-grained reactivity model of Solid.js using Signals, and understand why direct DOM updates outperform Virtual DOM reconciliation.

events.title: Runtime Validation with TypeScript
events.description: Bridge the gap between compile-time types and runtime data validation using libraries like Zod, ensuring type safety in network requests and user inputs.

events.title: Building a robust data layer with REACT query
events.description: Simplify application state by offloading network state to React Query (TanStack Query), handling caching, synchronization, mutations, and pagination seamlessly.

events.title: Debian GNU/Linux Packaging Workshop
events.description: Hands-on guide to compiling source code, defining dependency manifests, and building standard Debian packages (.deb) for distributions like Ubuntu and Swecha OS.

events.title: Digital Arts Workshop
events.description: Explore creative coding, vector graphic design, image manipulation tools, and layouts utilizing FOSS software to create premium, eye-catching visual assets.

events.title: Getting started with VUE.JS
events.description: Learn the basics of Vue.js, single-file components, the Composition API, reactive state management, and building interactive, clean user interfaces.

events.title: Building Portable and reliable microservices with DAPR
events.description: Simplify microservices architecture using the Distributed Application Runtime (Dapr) to handle state management, pub-sub messaging, and service-to-service invocation.

events.title: Observability : Now, Next, Later
events.description: A comprehensive discussion on distributed systems monitoring, structured logs, OpenTelemetry traces, metrics collection, and predicting outages.

events.title: Reducing alert fatigue for Prometheus alerts on Kubernetes
events.description: Design intelligent alerting systems inside Kubernetes. Learn how to silence noise, group related notifications, and write actionable alerts with Prometheus and Alertmanager.

events.title: Android Development Workshop
events.description: Introduction to modern Android application design, using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose to build fluid layouts, fetch remote APIs, and manage state.

events.title: Building Next-Gen Application with LLMs
events.description: Leverage models like Llama and Mistral locally or via cloud APIs. Learn to build agentic workflows, function calling pipelines, and custom prompt structures.

events.title: Machine Learning on Web in 2023 and Future
events.description: Bring AI algorithms directly to the browser. Explore TensorFlow.js, web-based classification models, client-side computer vision, and privacy-first local processing.

events.title: Exploring Data Science
events.description: Master data cleaning, exploratory data analysis (EDA), visualization using Pandas, NumPy, and Seaborn, and learn training principles for supervised models.

events.title: Multi-track: Cloud Computing
events.description: A cloud track detailing design patterns on AWS and Azure, containerized workloads under ECS/EKS, auto-scaling, and infrastructure safety.

events.title: Multitrack : Modern Web Track
events.description: A deep look into next-generation frameworks (Next.js, Remix), bundlers, micro-frontends, edge caching, and server-side state optimization.

events.title: Rust Language
events.description: Introduction to Rust's memory management system without a garbage collector. Deep dive into ownership, borrowing rules, and lifetimes.

events.title: Go Language
events.description: A hands-on Go workshop explaining fast concurrency patterns with Goroutines and channels, strict typing, interfaces, and backend router layouts.

events.title: The Power of Effective Prompt Engineering
events.description: Optimize AI model behavior. Learn Few-Shot Prompting, Chain of Thought (CoT), ReAct framing, and programmatic structures for reliable LLM outputs.

events.title: Future of GenAI
events.description: Explore custom model fine-tuning, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) structures, vector databases, and scalable deployment pipelines for generative AI.

events.title: UI Design for Software Development
events.description: A visual-focused seminar detailing interface hierarchy, grid layout rules, typographic choices, colors, and building design systems developers enjoy.

events.title: I&ML for Developer Productivity: Using LLMs for Software Development
events.description: Integrate LLM code generation, context-aware autocompletes, agentic code analysis tools, and automated unit testing into your local development workflows.

events.title: Go Language Mini-BootCamp / Introduction to Go Language
events.description: Introductory bootcamp to Go syntax, concurrency loops, interfaces, maps, slices, standard library servers, and building basic API endpoints.

events.title: Go Language Mini-BootCamp / Developing Microservices
events.description: Architect robust services in Go. Implement request routing, database connection pools, middleware authorization, structured logging, and unit tests.

events.title: The Power of Small Language Models (SLMs) | AI, ML
events.description: Examine the benefits of small language models (under 10B parameters) like Phi-3 and Gemma. Learn how offline, local model hosting provides low-latency, private AI execution.

events.title: Javascript Hyderabad November 2023
events.description: A deep dive into advanced JavaScript concepts, including closures, prototypical inheritance, the event loop, web workers, and modern language features.

events.title: Multi - Track DevDay — Cloud Computing | AI, ML | Go Language
events.description: A collaborative multi-track event where developers learn about scalable cloud hosting structures, local model training, and concurrent systems in Go.

Hemanth M.name: Hemanth M
Hemanth M.bio: Hemanth M is a senior web architect with over a decade of experience designing API-first systems, headless CMS architectures, and JAMstack platforms. He is a frequent contributor to open-source content management projects.

Roja Rani.name: Roja Rani
Roja Rani.bio: Roja Rani specializes in Python web frameworks, modular design, and data science pipelines. She is a dedicated mentor who has trained hundreds of students in building reusable Python packages and data modeling techniques.

Vamshi Krishna.name: Vamshi Krishna
Vamshi Krishna.bio: Vamshi Krishna is a frontend performance enthusiast. Expert in Astro, React, and server-side rendering, he works on building high-speed user interfaces and teaches modern state-management patterns in developer workshops.

Parvateesham.name: Parvateesham
Parvateesham.bio: Parvateesham has long-standing expertise in enterprise content systems and LAMP/LEMP stacks. He specializes in Drupal migrations, security hardening, database optimizations, and system administration.

Kiran Kumar Ambati.name: Kiran Kumar Ambati
Kiran Kumar Ambati.bio: Kiran Kumar Ambati is a build-tool enthusiast. He specializes in modern JavaScript compilers, build optimization, bundle size analysis, and modular application design using ESBuild, Webpack, and Vite.

Supriya Kotturu.name: Supriya Kotturu
Supriya Kotturu.bio: Supriya Kotturu is a cross-platform mobile developer. She works extensively with NativeScript, React Native, and web frameworks, helping developers write single-codebase apps that deploy natively to iOS and Android.

Shashikanth.name: Shashikanth
Shashikanth.bio: Shashikanth is an expert in workflow automation, DevOps tooling, and serverless backend systems. He has spent years designing integrations using n8n, Appwrite, and custom Docker container configurations to streamline enterprise workflows.

Krushi Raj Tula.name: Krushi Raj Tula
Krushi Raj Tula.bio: Krushi Raj Tula works at the intersection of JavaScript and systems programming. He is a Node-API enthusiast, writing high-performance native modules in C/C++ that interact directly with OS-level bindings.

Chaitanya Chokkareddy.name: Chaitanya Chokkareddy
Chaitanya Chokkareddy.bio: Chaitanya Chokkareddy is a tech visionary, CTO of Ozonetel, and a leading expert in telecom and AI. He builds enterprise cloud telephony products and researches prompt engineering, conversational AI, and Small Language Models.

Rohit Dandamudi.name: Rohit Dandamudi
Rohit Dandamudi.bio: Rohit Dandamudi is a Rust core enthusiast. He is passionate about static analysis, memory safety guarantees, and developing low-level concurrent network tools using Rust's async primitives.

Ranjith Raj Vasam.name: Ranjith Raj Vasam
Ranjith Raj Vasam.bio: Ranjith Raj Vasam is a container orchestration and cloud specialist. He designs highly resilient container environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Prometheus monitoring systems.

Bishwajit Jha.name: Bishwajit Jha
Bishwajit Jha.bio: Bishwajit Jha works in functional programming and compiler design. He studies type systems, type checking constraints, and category theory, helping developers write safer and more mathematically sound applications.

Azharuddin Mohd.name: Azharuddin Mohd
Azharuddin Mohd.bio: Azharuddin Mohd is a senior engineer specializing in Svelte, Go, and reactive programming. He focuses on light, fast frontend architectures and high-performance, concurrent backend server layers.

Piyush Mahapatra.name: Piyush Mahapatra
Piyush Mahapatra.bio: Piyush Mahapatra specializes in reactive systems, signal-based states, and browser compiler optimization. He focuses on micro-frontend systems and high-fidelity reactive styling layouts.

Praveen Puglia.name: Praveen Puglia
Praveen Puglia.bio: Praveen Puglia is an experienced frontend lead and tech educator. He writes extensively on TypeScript, type validation (Zod, Valibot), utility classes, and accessible web standards.

Ramana Venkata Katta.name: Ramana Venkata Katta
Ramana Venkata Katta.bio: Ramana Venkata Katta is a caching and state synchronization specialist. Expert in TanStack Query (React Query) and Redux, he designs offline-first architectures for web platforms.

Praveen Bammidi.name: Praveen Bammidi
Praveen Bammidi.bio: Praveen Bammidi is a long-time Debian contributor. He handles upstream packaging, configuration setups, kernel compilation, and open-source system security distributions for Swecha OS.

Pavan Gudiwada.name: Pavan Gudiwada
Pavan Gudiwada.bio: Pavan Gudiwada is a versatile technologist. He bridges creative vector design with container engineering, managing Kubernetes configurations, reducing alerting fatigue, and designing graphics on FOSS tools.

Tarandeep Singh.name: Tarandeep Singh
Tarandeep Singh.bio: Tarandeep Singh is a frontend engineer specializing in Vue.js, single-page application lifecycle rendering, and component hierarchies. He works on human resource system interfaces at Keka.

Subham Sharma.name: Subham Sharma
Subham Sharma.bio: Subham Sharma is an expert in cloud-native design, Go, and Dapr. He works on decoupling large systems into microservices, implementing message buses, event-driven designs, and high-volume data streams.

Aravind Putrevu.name: Aravind Putrevu
Aravind Putrevu.bio: Aravind Putrevu is a Developer Advocate at Elastic, focusing on search, logs, metrics, and distributed systems monitoring. He runs sessions globally on observability, telemetry, and index storage.

Hemasai charan K.name: Hemasai charan K
Hemasai charan K.bio: Hemasai charan K is an experienced mobile developer specializing in Kotlin, Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, and background system services design for enterprise mobile products.

Tarun Yekbote.name: Tarun Yekbote
Tarun Yekbote.bio: Tarun Yekbote specializes in Android architecture components, database syncing, mobile security, and offline-first native applications with optimized battery efficiency models.

JanakiRam MSV.name: JanakiRam MSV
JanakiRam MSV.bio: JanakiRam MSV is a prominent cloud and AI architect, analyst, and writer. He provides deep advisory consulting on edge computing, Kubernetes setups, and building custom LLM integration workflows.

Jason Mayes.name: Jason Mayes
Jason Mayes.bio: Jason Mayes is a leading advocate for TensorFlow.js and Web ML at Google. He helps millions of developers build smart client-side web apps using browser-based computer vision and deep neural networks.

Pranali Bose.name: Pranali Bose
Pranali Bose.bio: Pranali Bose is a data scientist specializing in NLP, dialect classification, and machine learning models. She works closely with WomenWhoHack, mentoring female developers in big data frameworks.

Ranga Karnam.name: Ranga Karnam
Ranga Karnam.bio: Ranga Karnam is an educational entrepreneur and founder of in28Minutes. He has trained over a million developers on cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, Spring Boot, and DevOps containers.

Vivek Viswanathan.name: Vivek Viswanathan
Vivek Viswanathan.bio: Vivek Viswanathan is a solutions architect specializing in cloud migrations, hybrid setups, infrastructure security, and designing distributed data systems at scale.

M Zubair Ahmed.name: M Zubair Ahmed
M Zubair Ahmed.bio: M Zubair Ahmed is a Javascript specialist. He has worked for years designing enterprise SPA structures, micro-frontend networks, node layers, and concurrent database synchronization modules.

Ganesh Katrapati.name: Ganesh Katrapati
Ganesh Katrapati.bio: Ganesh Katrapati is a full-stack engineer and AI specialist. He builds application pipelines integrating Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), vector storage systems, and local language models.

Akhil Teja.name: Akhil Teja
Akhil Teja.bio: Akhil Teja is a backend software engineer specializing in Rust, systems programming, and high-performance routing protocols. He is a primary mentor in regional Rust learning circles.

Vishal Jaishankar.name: Vishal Jaishankar
Vishal Jaishankar.bio: Vishal Jaishankar researches prompt engineering, agent frameworks, and LLM orchestration. He builds scalable interfaces that translate developer workflows into reliable language models queries.

Dr. Kamma K Babu.name: Dr. Kamma K Babu
Dr. Kamma K Babu.bio: Dr. Kamma K Babu is an expert UI/UX designer and design thinking consultant. He researches human-computer interaction (HCI) and collaborates with Swecha to teach design system building.

Mani Sai.name: Mani Sai
Mani Sai.bio: Mani Sai is a Go backend developer specializing in web protocols, database interfaces, API route design, and writing high-fidelity modular testing scripts.

Jeevan Reddy Ragula.name: Jeevan Reddy Ragula
Jeevan Reddy Ragula.bio: Jeevan Reddy Ragula is a senior backend engineer at EPAM. He specializes in Go-based microservices architecture, network performance optimization, and container security setups.

Srinivas Sripada.name: Srinivas Sripada
Srinivas Sripada.bio: Srinivas Sripada is a systems researcher specializing in machine learning, dialect modeling, and local Small Language Models (SLMs) deployment inside low-bandwidth edge computing networks.
